responsibility: This module implements GCC’s profiling and coverage infrastructure spanning profile generation, profile use, and gcov-based tooling. Its core compiler-side pieces manage instrumentation and reconstruction of execution data on GIMPLE/CFGs: profile.cc selects and inserts arc and value counters and rebuilds basic-block, edge, and function frequencies from gcda data; value-prof.cc handles statement-level value histograms and profile-driven transformations such as indirect-call and arithmetic/string specializations; auto-profile.cc integrates sampled AutoFDO profiles and maps them back onto functions, callsites, and CFGs; and profile-count.* provides the typed count/probability abstractions used throughout optimization. Around that, coverage.cc and gcov-io.* own the gcno/gcda file format, per-function counter objects, and compiler/runtime-facing serialization logic, while gcov-counter.def defines the canonical counter families. The same module also contains the user-facing gcov, gcov-dump, and gcov-tool programs for reporting, inspecting, merging, rewriting, and otherwise manipulating profile/coverage data offline. Overall, this is GCC’s shared profile-and-coverage subsystem: it connects instrumentation and sampled-profile ingestion to the internal execution-frequency model and to the external gcov file ecosystem used for PGO, AutoFDO, and source coverage reporting.
